Class MicronautRunnerExtension

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.gradle.MicronautRunnerExtension
public abstract class MicronautRunnerExtension extends Object
The packaging options of every archive the plugin builds, and its kill switch.

The plugin creates it as "micronautRunner". When a Micronaut plugin has created the micronaut extension, the same instance is also micronaut.runner, the block the Micronaut Gradle plugin's own Runner support reads, whatever order the plugins are applied in:

micronaut {
    runner {
        compression = 'STORED'
    }
}

Each option is the convention of the task property of the same name, so a value set on a task wins for that task. The facts of the build, such as the main class, the inputs and the archive name, are properties of the task only. Every typed option has a property here, whose convention is the packaging library's default when that default is unconditional; every option, typed or not, can also be set by name through getOptions().

Since:
1.0
